# ZYD Signage

> Factory-direct signage manufacturer in Dalian, China, producing wayfinding, architectural and illuminated signage for global B2B projects since 2006.

ZYD Signage is the trading name of Dalian Zhiyudao Signage & Tech. Co., Ltd. The company manufactures custom signage at its own production base in Dalian and delivers finished projects internationally. Every fact below is also stated on the linked page.

## Core facts

- Legal name: Dalian Zhiyudao Signage & Tech. Co., Ltd.
- Founded: 2006
- Production base: 20,000 sqm in Dalian, Liaoning, China
- Minimum order: 1 unit (MOQ 1)
- Typical production lead time: 7-14 days, depending on scope and quantity
- Warranty: 3-5 years on supplied signage
- Delivery: DDP shipping, customs and duties handled, to clients in 50+ countries
- Business model: factory-direct, serving B2B projects rather than consumers
- Email: zhengran@zydsign.cn
- Website: https://www.zydsign.com

## Product lines

- [Airport Wayfinding](https://www.zydsign.com/products/architectural-wayfinding-system/index.md): High-precision indoor and outdoor directional systems.
- [Medical Signage](https://www.zydsign.com/products/medical-care-signage/index.md): Specialized healthcare signage systems for hospitals.
- [Landscape & Furniture](https://www.zydsign.com/products/custom-landscape-furniture/index.md): Bespoke outdoor landscape branding and seating.
- [Illuminated Letters](https://www.zydsign.com/products/custom-halo-lit-letters/index.md): Premium front-lit and halo-lit 3D LED channel letters.
- [LED Light Boxes](https://www.zydsign.com/products/ultra-slim-led-light-box/index.md): Ultra-slim and projecting LED light boxes for retail.
- [Monument Signs](https://www.zydsign.com/products/outdoor-pylon-monument-sign/index.md): Large-scale pylon signs and entry identification.
- [LED Neon Signs](https://www.zydsign.com/products/custom-led-neon-sign/index.md): Vibrant custom neon flex for branding and interior decor.
- [Metal & Acrylic Signs](https://www.zydsign.com/products/metal-acrylic-logo-sign/index.md): Precision laser-cut corporate logos and plaque systems.
- [Complete Systems](https://www.zydsign.com/products/complete-signage-system/index.md): One-partner coordinated signage programs for global rollouts.
- [Outdoor Waste Bin](https://www.zydsign.com/products/outdoor-waste-bin/index.md): Custom waste bins for hospitality, commercial, and public-space projects.
- [Custom Planter Box](https://www.zydsign.com/products/custom-planter-box/index.md): Architectural planter solutions for commercial entrances and public spaces.
- [Acrylic Desk Sign](https://www.zydsign.com/products/acrylic-desk-sign/index.md): Free-standing counter and desk signs for reception and front-of-house.
- [Portable Metal A-Frame Sign](https://www.zydsign.com/products/portable-metal-a-frame-sign/index.md): Free-standing A-frame signs for pavements, forecourts, and event stands.

Full product index: https://www.zydsign.com/products

## Buying guides

- [How Much Do Custom Channel Letters Cost?](https://www.zydsign.com/guides/how-much-do-custom-channel-letters-cost/index.md): The project inputs that shape a channel letter quotation, from artwork and dimensions to lighting, finish, mounting, and delivery scope.
- [Front-Lit vs Halo-Lit Channel Letters](https://www.zydsign.com/guides/front-lit-vs-halo-lit-channel-letters/index.md): How front-lit and halo-lit letters differ in visual effect, mounting background, service planning, and the details a buyer should confirm.
- [How to Choose the Right Sign for Your Business](https://www.zydsign.com/guides/how-to-choose-the-right-sign-for-your-business/index.md): A practical framework for choosing pylon, monument, building, wayfinding, or illuminated signage around the real site and message.
- [304 Stainless Steel vs Galvanized Steel](https://www.zydsign.com/guides/304-stainless-steel-vs-galvanized-steel-outdoor-signs/index.md): Material-selection logic for outdoor signs, comparing 304 stainless steel and galvanized steel by exposure, finish, and fabrication.

Full guide index: https://www.zydsign.com/guides
